title: C_Encrypt OAEP non-soft backend crash
description: C_Encrypt for CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP casts key_priv to wp11_soft_key_t* without checking backend type (wp11_pkcs11.c ~line 5528). Flash/fsdir backends store key_priv as wp11_key_entry_t*, so the cast is UB and will crash or corrupt memory. C_Decrypt had the same bug and was fixed this session (detect backend_ops == &wp11_backend_soft_ops; for non-soft backends create a temporary soft key from entry DER bytes, then free it). C_Encrypt needs the same pattern.
